additional_concerns: Preservation of an existing application's processing does not expressly establish a permanent substantive exclusion from relief. Candidates that negate pending status fixed at commencement implement that additional inference; later approval, withdrawal and resubmission are not resolved by the supplied source.

The explicit commencement date supports assessment from 28 November 2025, but does not establish a universal implementation-date test. The introductory reference to immediate effect should be read alongside the explicit commencement provision.

Item (ii) does not expressly impose a separate home-regulator-supervision test. The introductory purpose statement and item (i)'s supervision condition should not automatically become an additional item (ii) restriction.
The two supplied missing dependency IDs have no descriptive mapping to particular authorities. Neither can safely be identified as the FAQ dependency.
Home compliance and classifications of novelty, complexity and possible local policy implications remain supplied judgments. The formulas do not establish those facts or overall compliance.

Different placement of commencement and legacy status in scope versus result intentionally produces different answers: OUT_OF_SCOPE versus FALSE. These candidates must not be treated as interchangeable.
